Run bun run ci:status and bun run ci:watch after git push to poll GitHub Actions without asking.
When operator requests push-fix loop (perfect push / CI green): commit, push, ci:watch, triage gh logs/artifacts, fix with L0-L4 only, re-push up to 5 cycles — see rule 94-ci-push-fix-loop.
Run bun run gate:local-autopilot for full local test ladder (sequential · low-spec) without asking.
Run bun run gate:local-autopilot -- --from=<step> to resume after AI fixes a failure.
Invoke @test-autopilot subagent for local test + auto-fix loop without asking.
Run bun run stack:push-remote for remote migration sync without asking (after local code change — SQL verification is CI authoritative).
Run session hygiene (cursor:purge, cursor:work-end, cursor:session-end, e2e:kill, clean) without asking.
Run bun run cursor:work-end after any test session, gate:local-autopilot, or implementation closeout without asking.
Use Supabase MCP readonly tools on project yocjhjsdwoijfdrehzoq without asking.
Follow operator-approved DEMOLITION_PLAN or Phase R plan without asking for each file touch in scope.
